title: Flying general: the two generals may not face each other on an open file
rationale: The horse on e5 is the only piece between the two generals, and all eight of its moves leave file e. Every one of them is illegal, because a position in which the generals face each other down an empty file may not be reached. The general's own three moves remain, e1e2 among them: the rule is about the open file, not about the general moving.
